openapi.title: Overpass simulator API
openapi.description: Providers simulated from their public documentation, with no link to the real providers: every provider is unofficial. Authenticate with an Overpass test key where the provider expects its credential. The Overpass-Scenario header picks the scenario of one call.
openapi.listen: Receive your key's webhooks on your computer with overpass-cli (SSE stream)
openapi.listenDescription: Opens an outgoing connection that carries each webhook with its raw body and headers. After a disconnection, send Last-Event-ID to receive the webhooks you missed.
openapi.result: Report what the local server answered
openapi.scenarioHeader: Scenario of this call, instead of the key's
openapi.webhook: Simulated webhook, signed as the provider documents it
